_comment: Edit this file to add or change a source. A source is only crawled when its access_rule is open_api or crawl_allowed, so changing a rule is a security decision and must carry its evidence in `basis`.

sources.name: Funder apply and call-for-proposals pages
sources.basis: A class of pages on each funder's own site, so that host's robots.txt governs. This is the weekly sweep that finds open calls.

sources.name: NGOBox RFP and EOI listings
sources.basis: The site answered 403 to automated requests, including for robots.txt, so it actively blocks bots. Ask Renalysis Consultants for permission or a feed.

sources.name: Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
sources.basis: robots.txt timed out when checked from outside India, so whether automated access is permitted is unknown. Check again from an Indian network.

sources.name: PSU CSR proposal templates
sources.basis: Public documents downloaded by hand from each PSU's CSR pages. Used to learn proposal formats and themes rather than as a data feed.

sources.name: Tata NGO due-diligence guidelines
sources.basis: robots.txt allows this path, blocking only restricted folders. Read to learn what due-diligence areas a funder checks, not for entity data.

sources.name: Tata CSR Assessment Framework
sources.basis: Same host rule as the due-diligence guidelines: robots.txt allows this path. Read to learn how a funder rates a partner.
